content: Screening for prediabetes or type 2 diabetes in children and adolescents should begin at the onset of puberty or at age 10, whichever occurs first, if they have risk factors. Risk factors include being overweight, defined as having a body mass index (BMI) at or above the 85th percentile for age and sex, or being obese, defined as having a BMI at or above the 95th percentile. Additionally, at least one other risk factor must be present to warrant screening. If the initial screening results are normal, it is recommended to repeat the screening at least every three years. However, more frequent screening may be necessary if the child’s BMI increases over time.
